WoW: Forever

Frost Mage

Freeze the target, then hit it for four times the damage (+300%). Icy Veins: "with FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec., melee enemies will often not even reach you before killing them."

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 31, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. These pages follow the hotfix Blizzard pushed to the launch realms on October 30, read from the game's hotfix data. Blizzard has not announced it, so it may still move before November 4. Where a spell's tooltip disagrees with the text here, trust the text: tooltips can lag behind a hotfix. Blizzard's one-point milestone talents sit at 11, 16, 21 and 31 points, with the 16-point one new in Forever, so Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownDeals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 200% increased damage to Frozen targets. arrives at exactly level 20 and Ice BlockIce BlockLevel 4 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost15 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secYou become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells. at 25. No source had posted a level 30 build when this page was written. The level 30 line below extends our level 20 lists using the full talent tree's point costs. No guide has recommended it.

What Frost is for

FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec. 3/3 gives every Chill effect you apply a 15% chance to freeze the target. Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownDeals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 200% increased damage to Frozen targets. is instant, on an 8-second cooldown, and hits a frozen target for +300%. ShatterShatterTalentCastInstant 3/3 then adds 50% crit against that frozen target for three points.

Icy Veins rates it 3.5/5 for levelling, under the heading "Smooth and Steady, but Not Fast"; Wowhead and ClassicWoW.gg publish no levelling score. Its verdict: "Frost Mages are going to have a comfortable time leveling… slowing and chilling everything they fight keeps them safe."

The drawback, in the same source's words, is "the constant need to stop for mana" — the "not Fast" half of its heading. You will drink often.

On damage the published line is "Frost Mage won't top the damage meters, but few specs are as safe or as consistent."

Stat priority

Icy Veins is the only one of the three tracked sources that ranks Frost's stats; its order:

  1. Hit — "capping your Hit Chance is a high priority". Nobody publishes the actual cap: "There will be a cap where you can stop investing in this, but we don't know what it is yet."
  2. Spell Power (Frost) — scales every spell. It does not scale your wand, per Blizzard's notes
  3. Critical strike — "Frost Mage is a crit-based spec": Ice ShardsIce ShardsTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%. doubles the crit-damage bonus at 5/5
  4. Spirit — "Frost Mages have limited tools for resource management, so Spirit will be a good stat to increase where you can"
  5. Intellect — a bigger mana pool for a whole pull, plus a small crit bonus
  6. Stamina — a dump stat that comes along for free on most gear (Agility and Strength trail further behind, and Strength is explicitly "not useful")
